string-array.name: novidades
string-array.item: Top bar with one rule for everything: it shows what is happening now with the chosen item — On air, Recording, Playing, Stopped at, Connected — with % and time left
Series, movies, podcasts and app videos stopped halfway show how far you got (e.g. “Stopped at T1 E1 · 35% · 43 min left”)
Home (Home Assistant) finds itself again on the network when the computer changes address: nothing to set up
Windows: the TV always shows under Network with its panel, and the TV drive has an “Open the TV panel” shortcut that follows the TV’s address

string-array.name: roteiro_perguntas
string-array.item: With Series in focus, does the top left show “Stopped at” with the episode, % and time left, and with TV “On air” with %?
Does the Home screen (lights) open normally?
On the computer, does the TV show under Network, and does the panel shortcut on the TV drive open the panel?
